response.justification: Bogdan has a strong background in software development with experience in geospatial data (GISCollective) and distributed systems (Dunnhumby, re:cinq), but lacks direct experience with modern C++ or Rust for routing/navigation pipelines. His expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, and DLang, while valuable, does not align closely with the core technical stack or problem domain. His recent roles focus more on AI-agent infrastructure and pricing optimization rather than geospatial data processing or routing systems.
strengths: Experience with geospatial data platforms (GISCollective) and open-source contributions
Strong background in distributed systems and low-latency applications (Dunnhumby)
Proven ability to work across full technical stacks and adopt new languages/tools
concerns: No demonstrated experience with modern C++ or Rust, which are primary requirements
Limited exposure to routing/navigation systems or data pipeline optimizations for global users
Recent roles focus on AI-agent infrastructure and pricing, not geospatial routing or high-scale data processing
